_comment: THE PUBLISHED-PRICE ALLOWLIST. Shared, on purpose, by netlify/functions/checkout.ts (what a visitor may buy) and scripts/sync-pricing.mjs (what the site may print). One file so the two can never disagree: a price the site advertises but cannot sell, or sells but does not advertise, are both bugs this shape makes impossible. The same cross-boundary import that netlify/functions/events.ts already does with events.json. ADDING A SLUG PUBLISHES A PRICE — the non-public warm-lead price stays sellable in Stripe and invisible here simply by never being listed.
